# utilities.data_transform_library.nc_to_df

### utilities.data_transform_library.nc_to_df(fp: [str](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str), variable: [str](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/stdtypes.html#str) | [None](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/constants.html#None) = None, time_idx: [int](https://docs.python.org/3/builtins/functions.html#int) = 0) → DataFrame

Convert NetCDF (.nc or .nc4) to DataFrame, optionally selecting variable and time index.
